% Pattern: number/option-on. A local style file declares theorem in the block
% of an option and again in its \else block, and the document gives the
% option, so the \else block does not run: theorem has a counter of its own
% within the section, and the theorem after a lemma is 1.1. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 1.2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[theorem-section]{theorems}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lemma} Every compact space is bounded. \end{lemma}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every point is closed. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
